seo.title: zapzero · Inbox zero for WhatsApp
seo.description: Clear your WhatsApp. AI triages every chat and drafts replies in your own voice. No bot, no risk, never leaves your Mac.

sections.title: Clear your WhatsApp.
sections.subtitle: Inbox zero for WhatsApp. No bot, no risk, never leaves your Mac.
sections.body: AI reads your chats right there on your Mac and tells you who's waiting on you. For each one, it leaves a reply written your way. Press Y, WhatsApp opens with the text ready, you hit Enter. Next.

steps.title: Reads your Mac. Only reads.
steps.text: zapzero opens WhatsApp Desktop's local database read-only. No extra linked device, no side API, and your chats go to no server of ours.

steps.title: AI triages everything.
steps.text: Who's waiting on whom, how urgent it is, who this person is to you. Fractions of a cent per chat. And for everyone waiting on you, a draft in your own voice.

steps.title: You clear it.
steps.text: Y opens the chat in WhatsApp with the reply typed in. You check it and hit Enter. Commitments (dates, prices, yes or no) come [in brackets] for you to fill.

sections.title: Categories say when.
sections.body: Besides urgent, this week or stale, every chat gets an area: client, hiring, family, someone trying to sell you something. Open Clients and see only the clients waiting on you.

items.q: Is it safe for my number?
items.a: Yes. zapzero doesn't connect to WhatsApp: it reads, read-only, the database the official app already keeps on your Mac. No bot, no extra device, no unofficial API, which is what usually gets numbers banned. To WhatsApp, it's just you using the app.

items.q: Does it send messages by itself?
items.a: Never. It opens the chat with the text typed in and stops there. You hit Enter. And anything that's a commitment (a date, an amount, yes or no) comes in brackets for you to decide.

items.q: Does it work on Windows? On iPhone?
items.a: Not yet. For now it's Mac only, with WhatsApp Desktop installed. The panel opens in any browser on your private network (Tailscale), phone included, but the Mac is what reads the chats.
No one at zapzero: we have no server with your chats. Each chat's excerpt goes only to the AI model you pick, with your own key. With a local model, not even that leaves the Mac.
You only pay for the AI, directly to the provider. In practice: US$ 0.09 to triage 1,600 chats and draft 110 replies. With a local model, nothing.
No. It runs as an app inside deco Studio, or on its own in the browser.
Not yet: the panel is in Portuguese for now. English is on the roadmap, and contributions are welcome.
